lines.zh: 踏步向前，沉重的脚步声回响山谷。
lines.en: Steps forward, heavy footsteps resound in the valley.

lines.zh: 挥舞长矛，每一次挥动都显露出威严。
lines.en: Wields a long spear, each swing exudes authority.

lines.zh: 盔甲摩擦，金属声与脚步声交织。
lines.en: Metal armor rubs, blending with footsteps.

lines.zh: 举起盾牌，防护的姿态坚不可摧。
lines.en: Raises a shield, a posture of unbreakable defense.

lines.zh: 警惕地注视四周，长枪随时准备战斗。
lines.en: Looks around cautiously, long spear ready for battle.

lines.zh: 向前移动，每一步都充满力量。
lines.en: Moves forward, each step filled with power.

lines.zh: 挺胸阔步，行进间展现威武之姿。
lines.en: Takes strides with a majestic bearing.

lines.zh: 缓缓移动，战甲在行走中发出声响。
lines.en: Moves slowly, armor making noise with each step.

lines.zh: 行走中，手中武器不离视线。
lines.en: Weapon never leaves his line of sight while walking.

lines.zh: 稳重前行，仿佛大地也在颤抖。
lines.en: Proceeds with stability, as if the earth trembles beneath him.

lines.zh: 我走过秘界的石廊，甲片作响。
lines.en: I cross the realm's stone hall, plates ringing.
Spear to the ground, one step, one note.

lines.zh: 盔缨扫过门框，垂得很低。
lines.en: My helmet plume sweeps the door frame.

lines.zh: 我绕着这间屋走第三圈。
lines.en: I make my third round of this room.

lines.zh: 站在原地，手中长矛指向天际。
lines.en: Stands still, long spear pointing towards the sky.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，思索着战略战术。
lines.en: Looks down, contemplating strategies.

lines.zh: 环顾四周，寻找可能的威胁。
lines.en: Scans the area, searching for threats.

lines.zh: 轻抚手中的长矛，显得沉思。
lines.en: Runs a hand over the long spear, in thought.

lines.zh: 凝视远方，眼神中透露出决心。
lines.en: Stares into the distance, eyes full of determination.

lines.zh: 目光威严，仿佛能穿透一切。
lines.en: Intimidating gaze, capable of piercing through all.

lines.zh: 低头整理装备，确保无懈可击。
lines.en: Takes inventory, ensuring nothing is amiss.

lines.zh: 轻摇手中的长枪，放松警惕。
lines.en: Gently摇动长枪, relaxing his guard.

lines.zh: 站在那里，仿佛一座雕像。
lines.en: Stands there, like a statue.

lines.zh: 凝视前方，等待着命令的到来。
lines.en: Stares ahead, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢接活的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who takes the job.

lines.zh: 刀鞘上的锈，我擦了三遍。
lines.en: I have polished the rust off this scabbard thrice.

lines.zh: 这间屋的墙角，我记熟了。
lines.en: I know every corner of this room.
The war is over, but my hands will not rest.

lines.zh: 目光投向玩家，准备战斗。
lines.en: Gaze on the player, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察玩家，手持长矛。
lines.en: Cautiously observing the player, long spear at the ready.

lines.zh: 目光聚焦玩家，显示出警觉。
lines.en: Focuses on the player, showing alertness.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，手中握着盾牌。
lines.en: Staring at the player, shield in hand.

lines.zh: 警惕地看向玩家，手中长矛指向玩家。
lines.en: Cautiously looking at the player, long spear pointed at them.

lines.zh: 目光紧锁玩家，展现出严肃的神情。
lines.en: Eyes firmly on the player, a serious expression.

lines.zh: 目光审视玩家，手中长矛随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Examines the player, long spear ready for attack.

lines.zh: 目不转睛地盯着玩家，手中长枪紧握。
lines.en: Stares intently at the player, long spear firmly gripped.

lines.zh: 目光从玩家身上扫过，充满警惕。
lines.en: Scans the player, full of alertness.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，手中长枪准备出击。
lines.en: Stares at the player, long spear ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我上下打量你，像看新兵。
lines.en: I size you up like a recruit.

lines.zh: 你的靴子不合脚，我看得出。
lines.en: Your boots do not fit. I can tell.
Good eyes, weak shoulders.

lines.zh: 先把你的武器拿稳再说。
lines.en: Hold your weapon steady first.
You stand like someone who has never fought.
Let me see if you are worth teaching.
Wounded, I need healing!
This hurts!
My armor is broken!
I’m hurt, don’t attack!

lines.zh: 伤势严重，快带我离开这里！
lines.en: Severe injuries, take me away!
Stop, I’m injured!
Injuries from war, they sting!
These wounds are hard to heal!

lines.zh: 我需要时间疗伤，别打扰我！
lines.en: I need time to heal, leave me alone!

lines.zh: 别再打我，我已经受伤了！
lines.en: Stop hitting me, I’m injured!

lines.zh: 这剑刃闪耀，可助你击退敌人！
lines.en: Sharpened blade, to repel foes.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我的知识助你一臂之力！
lines.en: Come, let my knowledge aid you.

lines.zh: 我的力量源自无尽的战斗！
lines.en: My power comes from endless battles.

lines.zh: 与我交易，你将获益匪浅！
lines.en: Trade with me, you’ll gain much.

lines.zh: 看看我的战盔，坚固无比！
lines.en: Look at my helmet, so sturdy.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲能保护你免遭攻击！
lines.en: My armor protects you from attacks.

lines.zh: 用我的药剂，你将变得更强大！
lines.en: Use my potion, you’ll grow stronger.
Try my spoils, taste of victory.

lines.zh: 我的符文能赋予你力量！
lines.en: My runes give you strength.

lines.zh: 与我交易，你将变得无坚不摧！
lines.en: Trade with me, you’ll become invincible.
Avoid my blade.
My spear pierces all.
Block my attack with your shield.

lines.zh: 让我的枪头带给你死亡！
lines.en: Let my spearhead bring death.
Avoid, or you’ll be beheaded.
My axe splits rocks.
Step aside, my blade is deadly.
My arrows penetrate armor.
Dodge, or you’ll die.
Block my attack with your shield.
Come, learn battle with me.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣会教你战斗技巧！
lines.en: My mate teaches you combat.

lines.zh: 战斗是我们的生活方式！
lines.en: Combat is our way of life.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣交流，你会变得更强大！
lines.en: Talk to my mate, you’ll grow stronger.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣交谈，你会成为勇士！
lines.en: Speak with my mate, you become a warrior.
Come, fight enemies together.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣一起训练，你会变得更强大！
lines.en: Train with my mate, you’ll grow stronger.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣一起战斗，你将无坚不摧！
lines.en: Fight with my mate, you’ll become invincible.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣交流，你会成为真正的战士！
lines.en: Speak with my mate, you become a true warrior.
Come, face challenges together.
Take your shield, traveler.
This armor is for you.
Don't underestimate this gem.
My blade cuts through everything.

lines.zh: 这些药水将助你一臂之力。
lines.en: These potions will aid you.
This is a treasure of the Nether.
Take it, it will protect you.
I used it to defeat giants.
This axe is heavy.
This sword slays demons.

lines.zh: 我将注视你的每一个动作。
lines.en: I will watch your every move.
Now I see you.

lines.zh: 我的盾已经立在这条走廊里。
lines.en: My shield already stands in this corridor.
Your weakness is in my sight.
I will always pursue you.

lines.zh: 秘界的柜台后面，我盯着你。
lines.en: From behind the Secret Realm counter, I watch you.

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准你了，秘界的账要算清。
lines.en: I have you in my sights; the Arcana's debts are due.
Let us settle the blade's price first.
I will watch your soul.

lines.zh: 你无法隐藏，我已经瞄准。
lines.en: You cannot hide, I have you targeted.

lines.zh: 账要算清，先报你的名字。
lines.en: The books must balance, so give me your name.
I will guide your death.
You can't afford my price.
I will guide your end.
I will make you submit.
I will guide your destruction.
I will guide your failure.
You will submit to me.

lines.zh: 你这一手，我能挑出三处错。
lines.en: I can find three faults in that move.
Stand firm. Do not shrink back.
Charge with sword!
Swing the greatsword!
Slash with the blade!
A Precasia blade speaks first.
Sword attack!
Chop with the axe!
Swing the sword!
Swing at you!
Close combat with the sword!
Sword attack the enemy!
War erupts here!
The portal opens!
The fighting spirit awakens!
The war horn sounds!
The War General appears!
The master of the秘界 summons!
The breath of war descends!
The glory of war arrives!
Battle is about to begin!
The shadow of war appears!
The fire burns!
Fell and got hurt!
Flooded and hurt!
Boom, injured!
Shot, it hurts!
Magic hit, hurt!

lines.zh: 饿得虚弱，快帮我找食物！
lines.en: Starved and weak, help me find food!
Lightning hit, it hurts!
Void damage, injured!
